name: love-journey-mobile
description: Aplicativo Android do Love Journey (Capacitor) a partir do dist/ do repositório Front-End.

scripts.verificar: node --check scripts/preparar-web.mjs && node --check scripts/gradle.mjs && node --check web/app-android.js
scripts.sync: npm run preparar && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.apk-release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.aab: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
